rationale: Builds directly on the current 9x512 recurrent-tail best, but shifts the small bigram residual head out of the early training budget. The trunk and recurrent tail already carry the strongest local signal; waking the bigram path only after about 58% of the train budget tests an unspent output-path/speed tradeoff instead of another small LR sweep. This should slightly reduce early-step logit work, buy a few more trunk updates under the 600s cap, and let the bigram head act as a late local-order correction before the existing quant-aware endgame and exact int8+zlib evaluation.
title: Late Bigram Wake-In On Recurrent-Tail QK Best
